Global markets currently experience diesel fuel shortage, Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak told reporters.

"Prices are exorbitantly high in global markets, exactly for diesel. We see diesel prices in Europe, in the United States of America break records,” Novak said.

Such situation has occurred due to sanction restrictions, attacks against the refining infrastructure and closing of logistical transport routes, he added.
